patch.description: Hosted Qwen3 text model with optional thinking and a one-million-token context window.
patch.notes: The qwen-flash alias is documented as equivalent to qwen-flash-2025-07-28, whose suffix is a snapshot date. Official availability: August 1, 2025 (International/Global), August 5 (Beijing). Parameters and architecture remain undisclosed. Do not transfer specifications from open Qwen3 checkpoints or later numbered Flash models. Function calling is documented generally and for Beijing, but the exact-model regional tables mark other regions unsupported.
